Title: Silent Lynx Strix espionage - ipv4
Description: Silent Lynx operator server (Debian VPS, Baxet Group): payload host, implant C2, phishing and scanning; its open directory on port 8088 exposed the operation, and P.ps1 shells call back to it on TCP 46125. Source: CloudSEK – Off the Rails: inside an exposed Silent Lynx server https://www.cloudsek.com/blog/off-the-rails-inside-an-exposed-silent-lynx-server
RecommendedActions: Isolate host, investigate process tree and persistence; rotate credentials if confirmed.
